annotations.title: EVE Frontier Smart Storage Unit (SSU) Bonding-Curve Market Pricer

description: Computes dynamic bonding-curve bid/ask quotes in LUX and per-transaction anti-drain caps for a player-owned Smart Storage Unit (SSU). Use when setting automated market-maker buy/sell prices for a single SSU vending inventory; for scanning multiple SSUs across star systems to find profitable trade routes, use find_eve_ssu_arbitrage instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'resource_type' ('pricing_regime' defaults to 'inventory_balanced'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

pricing_regime.description: Bonding-curve slope aggressiveness; defaults to 'inventory_balanced' when omitted.

resource_type.description: EVE Frontier commodity or ore name to price (e.g. 'Crude Fuel Ore', 'Carbonaceous Alloy').

name: quote_eve_ssu_market

anti_drain_cap_per_tx.description: Maximum units allowed per single transaction to prevent inventory sweeps.

recommended_buy_price_lux.description: Bid price in LUX to offer pilots selling into the SSU.

recommended_sell_price_lux.description: Ask price in LUX charged to pilots buying from the SSU.

title: EVE Frontier Smart Storage Unit (SSU) Bonding-Curve Market Pricer
